findings.claim: As a Phase 2 overlay, the added Fatiha requests for help and guidance can place the focus's human recipient of the warning in a posture of dependence and directed seeking against the manifest enemy.
findings.mechanism: The focus human occurrence carries the ordinary human domain of the warning, while the external forms at 1:5 and 1:6 enact requests for help and guidance. Their contact gives the focus human a specific petitionary orientation without changing the pericope's narrative setting.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the warning alongside a concrete need for help and direction, so the human scene is not only exposed to danger but also oriented toward assistance.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory external overlay retained only for the exact 1:5 and 1:6 request surfaces. It does not turn 12:5 into a prayer, equate the focus human with worshippers, or import the whole Fatiha into the pericope.

epistemic.reason: The exact external request surfaces and focus return are supplied, but no external candidate or connection record nominates this contact; it is retained as a bounded Phase 2 authoring inference.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: insan türü ve bu türden bir kişi
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan türünü, insanların oluşturduğu topluluğu veya bu türün tek bir üyesini görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında adlandırır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus human occurrence names the human domain in which the manifest enemy acts.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The external 1:5 request for help and 1:6 request for guidance enact dependence and directed seeking.
branch_activations.activation: The human carrier meets the petitionary acts and gives the warning a concrete orientation toward assistance and a guided route.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The human scene can be heard as both vulnerable to an enemy and turned toward help and direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The external contact is an overlay only; it does not transfer worship or guidance meanings into the focus human noun.

friction_notes: All 13 supplied macro candidates were reviewed exactly once and retained as dedicated findings; no candidate supplied semantic_obligations or required_branch_facets, so all exclusion arrays are empty.
